scope.indication: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis in adults

content.headline: Prior authorization support for your office
content.lede: Saltmarsh Access Navigator helps your staff with benefits verification, prior authorization paperwork, and appeals for eligible patients prescribed Tarnexa.
content.claimText: Saltmarsh Access Navigator provides benefits verification, prior authorization and appeals support, and a copay program for commercially insured eligible patients. Program terms and eligibility criteria apply.
content.fairBalanceText: Tarnexa is indicated for adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis who have had an inadequate response or intolerance to one or more TNF inhibitors. Boxed warning: serious infections, mortality, malignancy, major adverse cardiovascular events, thrombosis. See full Prescribing Information.
mslTalkingPoints: Copay program is commercial-only; government-insured patients are not eligible
Typical PA turnaround is tracked by the program, not promised to the HCP
Step-therapy requirements vary by plan; Navigator submits documentation of prior TNF inhibitor use
